mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, parent_id, name, code, node_type, leader_user_id, sort_order, status, remark, depth, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chengke_crm.department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{departmentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM chengke_crm.department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY path_ids, sort_order, created_at, id

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS display_name, u.username, u.avatar_url, d.name AS department_path FROM chengke_crm.sys_user u LEFT JOIN chengke_crm.department d ON d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND d.id = u.department_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status = 'active' AND (#{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR u.name ILIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username ILIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY u.name, u.id

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.depth FROM chengke_crm.department_closure c JOIN chengke_crm.department a ON a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.descendant_id = #{departmentId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.distance DESC

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM chengke_crm.department_closure c JOIN chengke_crm.department d ON d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND d.id=c.descendant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.ancestor_id=#{departmentId} AND c.distance>0 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL)::integer AS descendant_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.reference_type='user')::integer AS direct_member_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.reference_type='role')::integer AS role_reference_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.protected AND r.reference_type NOT IN ('user','role'))::integer AS business_reference_count, false AS has_hidden_references FROM chengke_crm.department_reference r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.department_id=#{departmentId}
SELECT coalesce(max(distance), 0) FROM chengke_crm.department_closure WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ancestor_id=#{departmentId}
